summary: Guest login fix VERIFIED — pressing guest-signin-btn now signs the user in and lands on Home tab (Accueil) with new-recording-fab visible. Full frontend regression run: 10/11 flows PASS, 1 KNOWN-ISSUE. Working: onboarding-next-btn ×2 → guest-signin-btn → home; bottom-tab navigation (via tab text) to Accueil/Dossiers/Recherche/Profil; folders shows 3 defaults (Patients, Réunions, Personnel); add-folder-btn → folder-name-input → folder-save-btn creates a folder that appears in the grid (verified TEST_QA_Folder appears); search-input accepts 'douleur' and shows empty-state ('Aucun résultat'); profile shows avatar/email/3 stat cards/language section/logout-btn; lang-en-btn switches UI to English (Home/Folders/Search/Profile confirmed); lang-fr-btn switches back to French; logout-btn signs out and returns to /auth/login onboarding; new-recording-fab opens /new-recording modal with mic button, 0:00 timer, 5 template chips + Importer un fichier audio + close-recording-btn; pick-template-btn navigates to /template-picker showing 5 templates with MED badge on Consultation SOAP & Consultation rapide; close-recording-btn closes modal; note detail (via SPA nav) renders correctly — tab-summary, tab-transcript, tab-actions, tab-plan render with proper SOAP/actions/plan content generated by Claude. TWO issues remain: (1) HIGH — bottom-tab bar items do not carry tab-home/tab-folders/tab-search/tab-profile testIDs (tests in playbook rely on them); had to fall back to text selectors. (2) HIGH — direct URL navigation to /note/{id} fails with 401 because authToken is an in-memory module variable in src/api.ts that isn't restored from AsyncStorage/localStorage before the note screen's useEffect fires (race). Breaks deep-link, refresh, and possibly post-recording nav. (3) MEDIUM — delete-note-btn on /note/{id}: clicking triggers no visible confirm and URL stays on the note page (probably uses React Native Alert.alert which is a no-op on web). Deprecated packages: none forbidden ones detected. RN warnings: props.pointerEvents & shadow* style props deprecated (harmless). Onboarding scenes use unsplash medical images — relevant.

ui_bugs.issue: Bottom-tab items lack testIDs (tab-home/tab-folders/tab-search/tab-profile). Playbook expects them. Currently only tab labels (Accueil/Dossiers/Recherche/Profil) are queryable via text.

Delete confirmation is likely using React Native Alert.alert which is a no-op on web. Tapping delete-note-btn produced no dialog and no navigation. Consider replacing with a cross-platform modal (Modal with Confirm/Cancel testIDs) so web/native both work and tests can validate. Alternatively expose 'delete-confirm-btn' testID inside a custom confirm.

integration_issues.issue: Direct navigation (page.goto('/note/{id}')) reloads the JS bundle. api.ts stores authToken in a module-scope variable which is only re-populated after AuthProvider hydrates the session from AsyncStorage. The note screen's useEffect calls api.getNote(id) before setAuthToken() has run, so request goes without Authorization header → 401 'Missing or invalid Authorization header' and the screen shows a blank spinner. In-app SPA navigation (from a list tap) works fine because authToken is already set. Fix: either await auth-ready state in the note screen, or in src/api.ts fall back to reading token from AsyncStorage/localStorage when authToken is null, or await getItem in the req() function.

react_native_issues.issue: Console: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — Legacy React Native shadow* props used across theme/shadow.card style. Migrate to boxShadow for RN 0.79+/Expo SDK 51+.
Console: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — some component passes pointerEvents as a prop rather than inside style.

action_items: Fix authToken race in src/api.ts: make req() read token from AsyncStorage when in-memory authToken is null (or expose an auth-ready promise the api awaits) so deep-linked /note/{id} and refresh work.
Add testIDs to bottom-tab items: tab-home, tab-folders, tab-search, tab-profile in app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx (tabBarButtonTestID or Tabs.Screen options.tabBarTestID).
Replace Alert.alert for note deletion in app/note/[id].tsx with a cross-platform Modal that has a confirm-delete-btn testID so the delete flow is testable and works on web.
Address deprecated RN style-props warnings: migrate shadow* → boxShadow and pointerEvents-as-prop → style.pointerEvents.
critical_code_review_comments: src/api.ts holds authToken as module-scoped mutable state — brittle for deep-link/hydration scenarios; safer to look up per-request or resolve via auth-ready promise.
backend server.py still >600 lines (from iteration 1); recommend splitting into routers.
Delete confirm relies on RN Alert.alert which behaves inconsistently on web preview.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all UI flows work; 1 deep-link auth bug, 1 web-only delete confirm quirk, missing tab testIDs)

seed_data_creation: Guest sessions created ad-hoc via /api/auth/guest. Test folder TEST_QA_Folder and test notes TEST_QA_ND / TEST_QA_Note created via /api/notes/from-text with valid Bearer token; some notes remain in DB because delete-on-web didn't confirm.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Guest login now works end-to-end (verified). To reach the tabs: root → onboarding-next-btn ×2 → guest-signin-btn. Bottom tabs currently have NO testIDs; use page.get_by_text('Dossiers', exact=True) etc. Note detail works via SPA nav but breaks on direct URL. When creating notes via API for testing, use page.evaluate(fetch(...)) from the same origin with Bearer <sn_session_token from localStorage>. Backend BASE_URL=EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL.
rca_of_issue: Bug 1 (deep-link 401 on /note/{id}): src/api.ts stores authToken in a module-scope variable set by AuthProvider after it hydrates AsyncStorage. On a hard navigation to /note/{id} the AuthProvider mount and the note screen mount are effectively concurrent; the note screen's initial useEffect fires api.getNote() before setAuthToken(session) has completed, so the request lacks the Authorization header → backend returns 401 → screen stays on loading spinner. Repro: (a) log in as guest, (b) copy the URL, (c) hard-refresh or open /note/<id> directly → blank spinner with console error 'Missing or invalid Authorization header'. Mitigation: in api.ts req(), if authToken is null, `authToken = await AsyncStorage.getItem('sn_session_token')` before building headers; OR gate the note screen render on an auth-ready boolean from useAuth(). Bug 2 (delete on web): tapping delete-note-btn calls Alert.alert which is a no-op on Expo Web; replace with custom Modal.
